scope: Visual review of final packaged offscreen renders; not a native window, continuous-motion, or FPS benchmark.
sunsetComparison: Skyline view 0, Direct Ray, lighting 3, identical camera with building lights on and off. Sun and sky stay fixed; emissive windows and their reflection contributions switch off.
correctionsAfterReview: Replaced invented 45.4m Welcome Pavilion with low glazed green-roof pavilion.
Replaced invented 37.8m Butterfly House with documented 18ft enclosure.
Reframed opening overview from east to retain whole pier and skyline.
Strengthened wheel blue/cyan strips and bounded warm/cool site lighting.
limitations: Procedural reconstruction guided by mapped footprints and photographs; interpreted details, not surveyed interiors.
Wheel and moored boats are static geometry.
Existing reflection/edge aliasing and path-tracer convergence limits remain.
